# partiteai_access_point_client (Resource)

A client of an access point. It signs in with its `client_id` and a secret, made with `partiteai_access_point_client_secret`, and gets a token from the access point.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_point_id` (String) ID of the access point the client signs in to. Changing it replaces the client.
- `name` (String) Resource name

### Optional

- `claims` (String) A JSON object copied into every token the client gets. It may not set `iss`, `sub`, `aud`, `exp`, `nbf`, `iat` or `jti`.
- `redirect_uris` (Set of String) Where the access point's authorization endpoint may send the client back to with a code, for an MCP client that only knows the authorization code flow. Each is an https URL, or an http URL to `localhost` or a loopback address, which matches on any port. A client with none can't use the authorization code flow.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) What the client signs in as
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated
